dialogues.jp: ＨＲ終了と共に、伸びをする。
dialogues.en: With the end of HR, I immediately stretch my body.
dialogues.text: With the end of HR, I immediately stretch my body.

dialogues.jp:
周囲でも、同じように伸びをしたり、友達と雑
談をしたりしている。
dialogues.en: Around me, my friends were stretching and chatting as well.
dialogues.text: Around me, my friends were stretching and chatting as well.

dialogues.jp: さっさと帰り始めている奴もいる。
週の半分が終わった。明日から後半戦だ。
dialogues.en:
The first half of the week was over. Tomorrow signifies the
second half.
dialogues.text:
The first half of the week was over. Tomorrow signifies the
second half.
